comment: ANCHOR: MARKET_EVENT_DETECT_RECEIPT_COUNTS_LQ434_20261107 — scripts/market_event_detect.py reports attempted_count and produced_count in the same unit (candidate rows upserted into market_event_candidates), with attempted floored at produced, so the n8n output verdict can never grade a normal run counts_inconsistent.
